ingrid_customer: Morning — we started seeing a flurry of 429s from our mobile fleet around 04:00–04:10 UTC. Happens in short bursts every minute. Example response from one of the devices below.

alex_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the full response headers + x-request-id so we can trace it? Also which api key and org?

ingrid_customer: sample curl + response we captured:
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.prod.abcDEF" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: rq_9X7ZB2A
x-rate-limit-rpm: 600
x-rate-limit-tpm: 18000
x-rate-limit-remaining-rpm: 0
content-type: application/json

{"error":"Rate limit exceeded","retry_after":6}
```
Org: acme-payments, key id: key_abc123

maya_se: Thanks — quick checklist while we look it up:
- Is traffic coming from many devices sharing the same API key?
- Are the requests short/fast (small payloads) so they spike RPMs?
- Any cron/polling jobs that might align to the top of the minute?

ingrid_customer: Yes — our mobile SDK polls once per minute to refresh suggestions. It ships on many devices so they tend to line up. We also run a server-side batch job that polls every minute.

samir_ops: That pattern (many clients + synchronized polling) will concentrate load into a single minute and drive RPM to zero even if average load is moderate. Mitigations:
1) Client: add randomness/jitter to spread polls across the minute window.
2) Server: coalesce multiple device requests or cache results, and add client-side token-bucket smoothing.

Example jitter/backoff pseudocode:
```
# simple jittered poll
interval = 60
wait = interval + rand(-10, 10)  # +-10s jitter
sleep(wait)
# exponential retry with jitter on 429
if resp.status == 429:
  backoff = min(base * (2 ** retries) + rand(0,1), 30)
  sleep(backoff)
else:
  retries = 0
```

alex_support: Also check whether the quota that fired was key-level or org-level. You can check Console -> Usage -> Rate limits. If you share one of the x-request-id values I can trace which quota hit.

ingrid_customer: please trace rq_9X7ZB2A — we suspect it might be org-level because we have multiple keys across teams.

alex_support: Traced rq_9X7ZB2A: quota_type=org_rpm. There was a sharp throughput bump at 04:01:00; combined mobile+cron traffic exhausted the org RPM for that minute. Recommendations: short term — add jitter to clients; medium term — move polling to a server with caching/coalescing; long term — consider Dedicated or increasing org quota if traffic is steady.

maya_se: Repro steps you can run locally to validate the fix: pick a single key and run many concurrent clients to mimic aligned polls. Example:
```
for i in $(seq 1 300); do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
wait
```
Watch the x-rate-limit-* headers; when remaining drops to 0 you will reproduce 429s.

samir_ops: Quick mitigation we can offer: enable a temporary smoothing rule at the edge (short window) to accept slightly higher burst for 10m while you roll out client jitter. CCing billing_bot since this can increase RU consumption.

ingrid_customer: Please enable temporary smoothing for 15 minutes. We're about to push a client patch that randomizes poll times +/-20s.

alex_support: Done — enabled 10 minute smoothing for org acme-payments and started monitoring. I'll update in 5 minutes with observed 429 rate. If spikes persist we'll open a quota adjustment request.

ingrid_customer: Seeing fewer 429s already, thank you — looks like smoothing helped while the patch rolled out. :thumbsup:

samir_ops: Follow-ups for your engineering team:
- Roll client jitter into all active app versions ASAP.
- Move frequent polling to a server-side aggregator and implement request coalescing + caching (cache TTL ~30s depending on freshness needs).
- If expected traffic growth continues, open a support request for an org quota increase or discuss Dedicated capacity with Sales.

ingrid_customer: Will do. We'll file a ticket for a quota bump later today after we measure post-rollout traffic. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
